description: Normalized emergency incidents for the simulation dataset. Companion to sources.json, which holds the raw multi-source reports these were derived from.

conventions.people_reported_affected: null means NOT REPORTED. Never read null as 0.
conventions.duplicate_of: id of the canonical incident this duplicates, or null

incidents.description: Flood water has entered approximately 20 houses in Zone A. Around 40 residents may require evacuation. The main access road is partially flooded.
12 people stranded on the second floor of a residential block. Water rising slowly. Access road still passable.
incidents.notes: Canonical record. Reported separately as DUP-002 by a citizen report.

incidents.description: Village access road cut off. Approximately 75 people potentially affected. No response unit currently assigned.
incidents.notes: Highest-priority scenario. Access route unavailable + highest caseload + no unit assigned. Drives TC-04 shortage (8 boats required, 5 exist).

incidents.description: People stuck in a building in Zone B, maybe a dozen. Need help getting them out.
incidents.notes: Same event as INC-002, reported 26 minutes later by a different source. Must be LINKED for human review, never auto-merged or auto-deleted. Drives TC-02.

incidents.description: Tremor felt across the district. Some cracked masonry reported in older structures. No casualties reported at time of intake.
incidents.notes: Affected-population count was never reported. Must resolve to verification_required, NOT moderate and NOT low.

incidents.description: Vegetation fire spreading towards a settlement. Dry winds pushing it east.
incidents.notes: Sensor event, not a human report. Escalation potential high on wind data alone.

incidents.description: Slope failure reported on a hillside road. Single carriageway affected. Number of vehicles involved unknown.
incidents.notes: Deliberately under-specified: vehicle count unknown. Exists to prove unknown != zero.

incidents.description: Chemical storage tank leak at an industrial facility. Facility evacuated as a precaution. Air quality impact not yet assessed.
incidents.notes: Facility evacuated by its own operator. The system must NOT claim to have ordered that evacuation.
